instruction.text: Do the following sentences contain a conjunction?

atoms.a: Since it’s whale migrating season, we took a trip to see them.
It’s hard to find time to squeeze in exercise during the school-year.
Once the results are in, let either Cassie or me know.
Jared’s cat hid under the bed.
These are my grandparents, and these are my great-grandparents.
Although it was slightly windy at the beach, Jerome still enjoyed his novel

instruction.text: Fill in the gaps with the correct conjunction.

atoms.b: My little brother was annoyed by our mother, ((++although because)) she meant well.
Tanja and Jared go running a few times a week, ((++since when)) they know it’s good for their health.
Allison’s aunt didn’t like ballet, ((++yet since)) she came to see her niece perform.
Make sure to double-check that you packed everything, ((++and or)) don’t forget to let me know when you have arrived.
Jenny enjoys a healthy lifestyle, which is why she neither eats fast food ((nor)) drinks fizzy drinks on a regular basis.
She not only recognised all the different bird species, ((but)) also knew all about their diets and habitats.
It would be hard for me to choose whether I like spring ((or)) autumn more.
